title: SEO, Information Architecture, Internal Linking & Commercial UX Audit
method: Full crawl of all 1443 sitemap-indexed pages via direct HTML parsing; real Google Search Console export (reports/search-console-export-2026-08-20/) used where cited; no traffic/ranking data invented.

cannibalization_analysis.method: 5-word-shingle Jaccard similarity across 118 English product/article/regional pages
cannibalization_analysis.conclusion: No cannibalization found among articles/regional pages; high similarity exists only among legitimate product-grade variants (expected, not a defect)

export_documentation_locale_gap.note: Specific, isolated locale-template gap, not a general trust-linking pattern (about.html and certificates.html are consistently well-linked in every locale)

search_console.unavailable_note: Query+Page joined attribution is not available in the export (separate tables only); candidate targets in this report are intent-based mapping, not observed attribution.
